observer: Only observation ptr/len and memory reads. All gestures use physical Playwright mouse events; explicitly marked host pause/resume probes alone dispatch synthetic platform events. No input ABI mutation or manual row materialization.

contract.slider: Persistent official createSlider controller; semantic ratio/phase input via Core
contract.scroll: inertia=true, deceleration=8; relative timed samples, no exact coast distance assumption

assertions.message: Production WASM and official three-webgl boot
Production observation confirms official UI package 0.3.0
Public ScrollView opts into inertia with deceleration 8
Visible line and level control found in public UI tree
Dragging the actual visible fill line reaches approximately 23 percent
Official controller is dragging while world pointer remains up
Releasing outside the slider ends capture; returning without a button does not change value
Outside capture stays with the slider and release ends official controller drag
A new physical start reactivates the official controller after outside release
Visible line reaches 23 percent again and releases
Dragging actual row content moves scroll offset and WASM virtual range
Content drag cancels row selection
Holding still for more than 100 ms before release suppresses coast
Returning after content-drag release does not leave scrolling captured
A row click with small pointer movement still selects that visible row
Wheel scrolling still advances offset and virtual range
Released content drag keeps moving in the same direction
Multiple successive coast intervals move and show velocity reducing
Relative timed samples show coast velocity decaying
Natural coast settles without another input
Natural coast stops before the content boundary
Inertial content drag never selects its starting row
New-press cancellation: release creates measurable coast
A new physical pointer down stops coast before that button is released
Coast remains stopped after the external button release
External apply button still activates once
Wheel cancellation: release creates measurable coast
Physical wheel input scrolls and stops the previous coast
Platform-pause cancellation: release creates measurable coast
Platform pause stops coast and resume does not revive it
Combobox still expands
Studio option appears
Combobox still selects Studio
Probe hold still presses once and remains held
Probe release outside ends hold once for both readers, with no phantom press on return
WASM frames and ticks advance throughout gestures
Actual JS/MJS/WASM Content-Type remains correct
No HTTP, request, page, console, status or fatal errors
